limitations: One browser and OS only; no human usability study.
Canvas row selection required coordinate action; some accessibility/Playwright locator paths did not match.
Screenshots show only visible viewport; long tables and right columns can require scrolling.
Hover tooltip interaction, 3D rotation, alternate-location dataset behavior, residue-name mismatch rejection, other operating systems and full repository suite were not tested.
Did not independently implement angle/RMSD geometry; equality to shipped output is reproducibility evidence.
